answer_1.quote: We apply FAMESUMM to a variety of backbone pretrained language models on three datasets including health question summarization, radiology report summarization, and medical dialogue summarization.

answer_2.quote: We report three metrics from existing literature based on question answering, medical entity, or textual entailment: QuestEval, FaR, and SummaC. We also use Concept F1 (C F1) to measure the coverage of medical concepts in reference summaries. General Quality We report ROUGE-1/2/L and BERTScore to assess the general summarization quality.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation by medical experts to judge coherence and faithfulness. Six doctors are recruited... Doctors are asked to identify incoherent and unfaithful summaries produced by all candidate models.
